mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, stock, category_id, detail FROM pms_product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category_id IN ( SELECT id FROM pms_category WHERE parent_id = #{categoryId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT #{categoryId} ) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.stock, p.category_id, p.detail, p.status, p.version, c.name AS category_name, pi.id AS img_id, pi.url, pi.product_id FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pms_product_img pi ON pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, name, price, stock, category_id, detail FROM pms_product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category_id IN ( SELECT id FROM pms_category WHERE parent_id = #{categoryId} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT #{categoryId} ) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, price, stock, category_id, detail FROM pms_product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, price, stock, category_id, detail, status, create_time FROM pms_product WHERE update_time >= #{minUpdateTime} ORDER BY update_time ASC
SELECT id FROM pms_product WHERE is_deleted = 0
